https://punchng.com/soldiers-kill-48-ter.body: In a post on the Nigerian Army’s X handle on Friday, the Acting Media Information Officer, Headquarters Joint Task Force (North East), Operation, HADIN KAI, Captain Mohammed Goni, said the engagements took place between October 29 and 30, 2026. In Bitta, troops successfully disrupted a terrorist assault on the night of 29 October. Ground forces, supported by air assets, overwhelmed the attackers and inflicted heavy casualties, forcing them to abandon their plan. In a separate but related operation, troops mounted a strong counter-attack against a large group of ISWAP fighters who struck NETTS Buni Yadi from the evening of 29 October into the early hours of 30 October. The roughly five-hour battle involved coordinated use of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) systems, as well as air and ground forces under the direction of the Theatre Command. “Troops recovered a large quantity of weapons and ammunition after the fighting. The items include 42 AK-47 rifles, five PKT machine guns, four General Purpose Machine Guns, one 60mm mortar, 105 AK-47 magazines, two video cameras, and thousands of rounds of various calibres of ammunition,” Goni said One soldier was killed in the engagements, while two others sustained minor injuries and are receiving treatment. Troop morale remains high. The military described the outcome as a major setback for the terrorists, significantly degrading their operational capacity in the theatre. Gilbert Ekugbe is a journalist at Punch Newspapers with over a decade of experience reporting on business and economic affairs. He covers markets, corporate developments, finance, and Nigeria’s broader economic landscape. His reporting is informed by extensive newsroom experience and a strong commitment to accuracy and responsible journalism, helping readers understand complex business issues

https://punchng.com/soldiers-kill-48-ter.body_zh: 尼日利亚陆军周五在 X 平台发文称，联合作战总部（东北部）HADIN KAI 行动代理媒体信息官 Mohammed Goni 上尉表示，交战发生于 2026 年 10 月 29 日至 30 日。10 月 29 日夜间，部队在 Bitta 成功挫败恐怖分子的一次袭击。地面部队在空中力量支援下压倒袭击者并造成重大伤亡，迫使袭击者放弃计划。在另一次相关行动中，部队对大批袭击 NETTS Buni Yadi 的 ISWAP 武装人员发动强力反击；袭击从 10 月 29 日晚持续至 30 日凌晨。这场约五小时的战斗协调运用了情报、监视、目标获取与侦察（ISTAR）系统，以及由战区司令部指挥的空中和地面力量。Goni 说：“战斗结束后，部队缴获了大量武器和弹药，包括 42 支 AK-47 步枪、5 挺 PKT 机枪、4 挺通用机枪、1 门 60mm 迫击炮、105 个 AK-47 弹匣、2 台摄像机，以及数千发各种口径的弹药。”交战中有一名士兵阵亡，另有两名士兵受轻伤，正在接受治疗。部队士气依然高昂。军方称，这一成果使恐怖分子遭受重大挫折，其在战区的作战能力显著下降。Gilbert Ekugbe 是《Punch Newspapers》记者，拥有十余年商业和经济新闻报道经验。他报道市场、企业发展、金融以及尼日利亚更广泛的经济形势。凭借丰富的编辑部经验和对准确性及负责任新闻工作的坚定投入，他帮助读者理解复杂的商业问题

https://punchng.com/ekiti-varsity-gets-n.body: Ekiti State University, Ado Ekiti, has received approval from the National Universities Commission to commence six new academic programmes. The approval was conveyed in a letter dated October 22, 2026, signed by the NUC Acting Director of Academic Planning, Dr Ayuba Mohammed, on behalf of the commission’s Executive Secretary. A statement issued on Friday by Adedoyin A.A., on behalf of the university’s Head of Information and Corporate Affairs, listed the newly approved programmes as BA Christian Theology, BSc Transport Management, BSc Security and Investment Management, BSc Information and Communication Technology, BSc Industrial Mathematics and BSc Criminology. The university said prospective students could apply for admission into the programmes from the 2027/2028 academic session. Adedoyin said the approval followed a resource verification visit by panels of experts who assessed the human and material resources available for the programmes to ensure compliance with national academic standards. 2027: Oyebanji sets 80% Ekiti vote target for Tinubu 2027: Oyebanji, Tompolo mobilise Ekiti voters for Tinubu’s re-election Ekiti Assembly confirms two commissioners, approves 10 SAs “This milestone reflects the university’s unwavering commitment to expanding educational frontiers and addressing the evolving needs of society and industry,” the statement said. The university added that the NUC had specified in its approval letter that the programmes were not authorised for part-time delivery and must retain their approved nomenclature. The Vice-Chancellor, Prof. Babatola Ayodele, expressed delight at the approval, describing it as a significant step towards achieving the university’s vision of academic excellence and innovation. Ayodele also appreciated the Ekiti State Governor and visitor to the university, Biodun Oyebanji, for his support, saying the approval reflected his commitment to strengthening the institution’s academic standards and global relevance. Abiodun Nejo

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: INCHEON — South Korea and the United States have complementary strengths and are capable of driving "great" progress in the nuclear sector amid a heated global race to develop next-generation reactors, a U.S. State Department official said. Christopher Klein, the deputy assistant secretary for nuclear nonproliferation and commercial competitiveness at the U.S. Department of State, made the remarks in an exclusive interview with Yonhap News Agency on Wednesday, saying the global landscape has transitioned into a "nuclear renaissance." "We are countries that both have a lot of experience and expertise, and when we work together ... we can achieve great things," Klein said during the interview on the margins of the International Ministerial Conference on Nuclear Power held in Incheon, west of Seoul. The three-day event, organized by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), was held in South Korea for the first time this year. Klein's comment comes amid growing attention to Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) — a new class of nuclear power plants — as countries seek reliable, carbon-free power to meet surging electricity demand driven by artificial intelligence (AI) and data centers. The technology is viewed as a more flexible and potentially less costly alternative to traditional large-scale nuclear power plants. It also comes as the U.S. and South Korea have drawn closer in the SMR sector, with local companies actively partnering with U.S. firms in the development and construction of such reactors. SK Group made financial investments in TerraPower LLC, a U.S. nuclear power company founded by Bill Gates, in 2022 to develop and commercialize SMRs in the U.S. and global markets. Doosan Enerbility, a local nuclear power plant builder, has recently won a supply contract from the U.S.-based SMR developer NuScale Power to supply a key reactor component. Such tightening private sector ties are being reinforced by institutional efforts. In July, South Korea, the U.S. and Japan signed a memorandum of cooperation (MOC) to establish a government-led framework to combine their respective strengths in the nuclear sector to jointly respond to surging energy demand and geopolitical competition. The three countries agreed to work together in deploying nuclear reactors, supply chain optimization, and knowledge transfer and training, according to a fact sheet on the MOC. The trilateral agreement is still in its early stages, in which the three countries are closely communicating to identify where to start deploying SMRs together, the U.S. official said. But Washington hopes to move "quickly" toward some actual projects "as soon as possible," he noted. "I think working together, the United States, the Republic of Korea and Japan, we wouldn't just survive. ... We would thrive, and I think we would be a formidable competitor around the world (in the nuclear sector)," the official said, referring to South Korea by its official name. "I look forward to some big announcements to come. There's a big market out there, and there's a competition, and you got to be in it to win it."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国国务院官员：韩国和美国能够在小型模块化反应堆领域取得“重大”进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 仁川——美国国务院一名官员表示，韩国和美国各自拥有优势互补的能力，在全球竞相开发下一代反应堆的激烈竞争中，能够推动核能领域取得“重大”进展。美国国务院负责核不扩散和商业竞争力的副助理国务卿Christopher Klein周三接受韩联社独家采访时说，全球格局已经转入“核能复兴”时期。Klein在首尔以西仁川举行的核能部长级会议场边接受采访时表示：“我们两国都拥有丰富的经验和专业知识，携手合作……就能成就一番伟业。”这场为期三天的活动由国际原子能机构（IAEA）组织，今年首次在韩国举行。Klein发表评论之际，小型模块化反应堆（SMR）日益受到关注。随着各国寻求可靠、无碳的电力，以满足人工智能（AI）和数据中心推动的用电需求激增，小型模块化反应堆作为一种新型核电站受到关注。这项技术被视为比传统大型核电站更灵活且可能成本更低的替代方案。与此同时，美国和韩国在小型模块化反应堆领域的关系日益密切，韩国本土企业正积极与美国企业合作开发和建设此类反应堆。SK集团于2022年对TerraPower LLC进行投资，以在美国及全球市场开发和商业化小型模块化反应堆。TerraPower LLC是一家由Bill Gates创立的美国核电公司。韩国本土核电站建造企业斗山能源近期获得了美国小型模块化反应堆开发商NuScale Power的供应合同，将提供一种关键反应堆部件。机构层面的努力进一步强化了双方私营部门之间的密切联系。今年7月，韩国、美国和日本签署了一份合作备忘录（MOC），计划建立政府主导的框架，整合三方在核能领域的优势，共同应对能源需求激增和地缘政治竞争。根据这份合作备忘录的事实清单，三国同意在部署核反应堆、优化供应链以及知识转移和培训方面开展合作。这名美国官员表示，三方协议仍处于初期阶段，三国正密切沟通，确定从何处开始共同部署小型模块化反应堆。不过，他指出，华盛顿希望“尽快”推动相关项目落地，“越快越好”。他说：“我认为，美国、大韩民国和日本如果携手合作，就不只是能够生存下去。……我们会蓬勃发展，而且我认为我们会成为全球核能领域一股强大的竞争力量。”他以韩国的正式国名称呼韩国。他还说：“我期待接下来能有一些重大消息发布。外面有一个巨大的市场，也存在竞争，只有参与其中才能赢得竞争。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Security chief outlines response to DMZ mine blast, Ukraine policy, possible expansion of Cheonghae Unit National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said Friday that Seoul expects to make progress on the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) at defense talks with Washington early next year. Speaking at a press briefing at Cheong Wa Dae, Wi said the two countries plan to hold another defense ministers’ meeting in Washington in December, followed by the annual Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) in early 2027. “We expect to make substantive progress on the OPCON transfer,” Wi said. He said U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reaffirmed Washington’s commitment to the transfer during Wednesday’s meeting with Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul in Cebu, Philippines. A senior presidential official said Washington was not opposed to the transfer itself, although the allies still needed to meet the agreed conditions. Wi also said the allies completed an assessment for full operational capability (FOC) verification during this year’s Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise, as part of the conditions-based transfer process. The SCM, traditionally held in the fall, had been expected to take place later this year but was postponed until early 2027. The allies have yet to announce when FOC verification will be completed or agree on a target year for the transfer. The postponement was due to scheduling issues, while the December talks are expected to cover North Korea’s nuclear and missile capabilities and broader alliance cooperation, according to the official. Regarding the land mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), Wi said the government would continue taking necessary measures following the incident that injured South Korean soldiers south of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) in September. “The government will continue to take necessary measures in response to the DMZ land mine explosion, guided by clear principles,” he said. Wi said Seoul conducted a joint investigation with the United Nations Command, demanded an apology and responsible measures from North Korea and destroyed the North Korean minefield at the site. The government also sent a letter to the U.N. Security Council and explained its position to other countries, he said. Wi added that the military was responding to North Korean crossings of the MDL under its operational guidelines, while Seoul had repeatedly proposed military talks to resolve differences in how the two sides identify the MDL. A senior presidential official said North Korea had rejected Seoul’s proposal for military talks, but the government had renewed its offer and was awaiting a response. Seoul would not recognize fences or other structures unilaterally erected by North Korea as an international border, the official added. On Ukraine, Wi said Seoul would maintain its support despite a diplomatic dispute with Kyiv over an alleged breach of a confidential agreement concerning the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea. “We will continue to participate in international efforts to support Ukraine as a responsible member of the international community, separately from this issue,” he said. He said Seoul was continuing consultations with Kyiv to establish the facts and restore bilateral trust. Seoul would also maintain its sanctions against Russia and export controls, he added. Wi also said the government was considering expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, a naval contingent deployed to protect shipping in waters near the Strait of Hormuz. “We are considering options, including expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, but the review has not yet been completed,” he said. He stressed that Korea would not become involved in the war under any circumstances, while considering limited measures to protect Korean commercial vessels, secure oil shipping routes and safeguard its citizens. Wi said the government would explain its plans to the public and the National Assembly once a decision is made. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔预计，2027年初与美国举行的防务会谈将在移交作战指挥权方面取得实质性进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac 说明政府针对非军事区地雷爆炸、乌克兰政策及扩大清海部队的应对方案。Wi Sung-lac 周五表示，首尔预计明年初将与华盛顿举行防务会谈，在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得进展。Wi 在青瓦台举行的新闻发布会上说，两国计划于12月在华盛顿再次举行防务部长会议，随后于2027年初举行年度安全战略磋商会议。他说：“我们预计将在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得实质性进展。”他表示，美国国防部长 Pete Hegseth 周三在菲律宾宿务与国防部长 Kang Shin-chul 会晤时，重申了华盛顿对移交战时作战指挥权的承诺。一名总统府高级官员说，华盛顿本身并不反对移交，但双方盟友仍需满足既定条件。Wi 还说，在以条件为基础的移交程序中，双方盟友已于今年“乙巳自由护盾”军演期间完成全面作战能力核查。安全战略磋商会议通常于秋季举行，原本预计今年稍晚举行，但已推迟至2027年初。双方盟友尚未宣布何时完成全面作战能力核查，也未就移交目标年份达成一致。该名官员表示，推迟是由于日程安排问题，而12月的会谈预计将讨论朝鲜的核与导弹能力以及更广泛的联盟合作。关于非军事区地雷爆炸事件，Wi 说，政府将继续采取必要措施，以应对今年9月军事分界线以南发生地雷爆炸并造成韩国士兵受伤的事件。他说：“政府将在明确原则的指导下，继续采取必要措施，应对非军事区地雷爆炸事件。”Wi 说，首尔与联合国司令部进行了联合调查，要求朝鲜道歉并采取负责任的措施，还摧毁了事发地点的朝鲜雷区。他说，政府还向联合国安理会提交了信函，并向其他国家说明了韩方立场。Wi 补充说，军方正依据行动准则应对朝鲜越过军事分界线的行为，而首尔已多次提议举行军事会谈，以解决双方对军事分界线认定方式存在的分歧。一名总统府高级官员说，朝鲜拒绝了首尔举行军事会谈的提议，但政府已再次提出，正在等待回应。该官员补充说，首尔不会承认朝鲜单方面设置的围栏或其他设施为国际边界。在乌克兰问题上，Wi 说，尽管首尔与基辅因据称违反一项有关将朝鲜战俘移交韩国的保密协议而发生外交争端，但首尔仍会维持对乌支持。他说：“我们将继续参与国际社会支持乌克兰的国际行动，并独立处理这一问题。”他说，首尔正继续与基辅磋商，以查明事实并恢复双边信任。他补充说，首尔还将维持对俄罗斯的制裁和出口管制。Wi 还说，政府正在考虑扩大并加强清海部队；这是一支部署在霍尔木兹海峡附近水域、用于保护航运的海军部队。他说：“我们正在考虑包括扩大和加强清海部队在内的各种方案，但相关评估尚未完成。”他强调，韩国无论如何都不会卷入战争，同时正考虑采取有限措施保护韩国商船、保障石油运输线路安全并保护韩国公民。Wi 说，一旦作出决定，政府将向公众和国会说明有关计划。该名官员表示，调动清海部队或扩大其行动区域均须获得国会批准，但政府尚未制定提交国会的方案。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: What began in 2001 as a small online sneaker community founded by a high school student has grown into a major platform that has helped protect Korea's domestic market from global retail giants while supporting an independent local fashion ecosystem. An analysis by global market research firm Euromonitor International shows that homegrown brands account for 70.1 percent of Korea's fashion retail market, significantly higher than the roughly 50 percent shares in Japan and China.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 2001年由一名高中生创办的小型线上运动鞋社区，如今已发展成一个重要平台，在支持本土独立时尚生态的同时，帮助韩国国内市场抵御全球零售巨头。全球市场研究机构 Euromonitor International 的一份分析显示，韩国本土品牌占韩国时尚零售市场的70.1%，明显高于日本和中国约50%的市场份额。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Musinsa, which is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) at an estimated valuation of around 10 trillion won ($7.49 billion), is drawing renewed attention in Korea's fashion and retail industries for its remarkable growth story. What began in 2001 as a small online sneaker community founded by a high school student has grown into a major platform that has helped protect Korea's domestic market from global retail giants while supporting an independent local fashion ecosystem. Its name originated from a Korean phrase meaning "a place where countless shoe photos are stored." Now marking its 25th anniversary, it has evolved into a major force in the fashion industry. According to industry sources Wednesday, Korea's fashion retail market is considered unusually resilient compared with those of other countries, where global fashion brands and large retail chains have gained stronger footholds. An analysis by global market research firm Euromonitor International shows that homegrown brands account for 70.1 percent of Korea's fashion retail market, significantly higher than the roughly 50 percent shares in Japan and China. The strength of independent labels is particularly notable. According to Euromonitor's 2025 country-by-country fashion retail data, independent designer brands account for 37 percent of Korea's fashion market, the highest share globally. This compares with 23 percent in China, 18 percent in Japan and 14 percent in the United States. Industry observers attribute the strength of Korea's homegrown fashion ecosystem, which has enabled domestic brands to compete with well-funded foreign players and replace billions of dollars' worth of imports, in part to Musinsa's role in nurturing emerging designers over the past 25 years. In the mid-to-late 2000s, Korea's fashion market was dominated by luxury labels, established fashion companies and department store retailers. Emerging designers with limited capital and distribution networks struggled to gain exposure, leaving the domestic market vulnerable to foreign competition. Musinsa founder Cho Man-ho kept the website running by selling limited-edition sneakers and even using money set aside for his university tuition. In 2005, he transformed the platform into an online fashion magazine, offering emerging brands a promotional channel at a time when few affordable alternatives existed. Early streetwear labels such as D-Antidote, Liful and Critic built their followings through Musinsa's editorial content, helping lay the groundwork for a new generation of independent brands. These included Covernat, Thisisneverthat, Matin Kim and Glowny, which later established themselves as prominent names in Korean fashion. Musinsa further demonstrated its content marketing capabilities in 2008 by successfully organizing a promotional event for the opening of global fashion retailer Uniqlo's store in Gwangju's Chungjang-ro district. It later expanded its collaborations with international brands such as Adidas and New Balance. Revenue from its content agency business helped Musinsa launch e-commerce services in 2009. In 2012, it adopted a consignment-based sales model for brands joining its platform, accelerating its growth into a major fashion retailer. As independent designer labels began generating tens of billions to hundreds of billions of won in annual sales through Musinsa without operating their own physical stores, the balance of power between online and offline fashion retailers began to shift. Brands that had built loyal customer bases on the platform subsequently secured prime locations in the young fashion sections of department stores, helping reshape an offline retail landscape once dominated by foreign labels. A key factor in Musinsa's contribution to import substitution has been its efforts to build infrastructure that helps independent brands operate and grow, rather than simply providing them with a sales platform. In 2018, the company launched Musinsa Studio, a fashion-focused shared workspace in Seoul's Dongdaemun district, providing smaller brands with essential facilities such as photography studios, workspaces and packing areas. The business has since expanded to five locations, including those in Seongsu, Hannam and Sindang. Musinsa has also operated an interest-free production financing program since 2015 to help emerging brands overcome cash shortages when purchasing fabrics and placing manufacturing orders for their seasonal collections. Over the past decade, the program has provided more than 400 billion won in cumulative financing, helping smaller labels manage cash flow and secure the funds needed to bring new collections to market. Musinsa established Musinsa Partners, a corporate venture capital subsidiary, in 2018 to identify and invest in promising fashion labels that have traditionally struggled to attract interest from conventional venture capital firms. The investment arm has so far invested approximately 100 billion won in more than 80 brands, including Thisisneverthat, Covernat, Mardi Mercredi and Rockfish Weatherwear. Musinsa's own fashion label, Musinsa Standard, launched in 2017, has also challenged global fast-fashion retailers with practical designs and competitive prices. The brand has established itself as a leading homegrown fast-fashion label, competing directly with international players such as Uniqlo, Zara and H&M. Its annual sales are expected to reach 700 billion won this year and approach 1 trillion won next year. Musinsa is now looking beyond defending its domestic market and pursuing an aggressive overseas expansion strategy. Launched in 2022, Musinsa Global aims to differentiate itself from Chinese e-commerce platforms such as Shein and Temu, which compete primarily on ultra-low prices, as well as European luxury fashion platforms. The company is seeking to capitalize on the distinctive designs and quality of Korean independent labels while building an omnichannel ecosystem that connects its global logistics infrastructure, including Musinsa Fulfillment Services, with overseas pop-up stores. The IPO process, which gained momentum earlier this month, is expected to provide another major source of funding for Musinsa's global expansion. With its valuation estimated at between 8 trillion and 10 trillion won, Musinsa plans to use the proceeds primarily to build overseas logistics networks and expand its global marketing operations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Musinsa助力本土品牌抵御全球时尚巨头
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Musinsa正筹备首次公开募股（IPO），预计估值约为10万亿韩元（74.9亿美元），其非凡的增长故事再次引起韩国时尚和零售行业的关注。2001年，它最初只是一家由高中生创办的小型线上运动鞋社区，如今已成长为大型平台，帮助韩国本土市场抵御全球零售巨头，同时支持本土独立时尚生态的发展。其名称源自一个意为“存放无数鞋履照片的地方”的韩语短语。如今迎来25周年，Musinsa已发展成为时尚行业的重要力量。据业界消息人士周三表示，与其他国家相比，韩国时尚零售市场被认为具有异常强的韧性，而全球时尚品牌和大型零售连锁店在其他国家已获得更稳固的市场地位。全球市场研究机构Euromonitor International的分析显示，韩国本土品牌占韩国时尚零售市场的70.1%，明显高于日本和中国约50%的占比。独立品牌的实力尤其引人注目。据Euromonitor的2025年各国时尚零售数据，独立设计师品牌占韩国时尚市场的37%，为全球最高占比，相比之下，中国为23%、日本为18%、美国为14%。行业观察人士认为，过去25年来，Musinsa通过培育新兴设计师，在韩国本土时尚生态的发展中发挥了重要作用，帮助本土品牌与资金雄厚的外国企业竞争，并替代了价值数十亿美元的进口商品。在2000年代中后期，韩国时尚市场由奢侈品牌、成熟时尚企业和百货商店零售商主导。资本有限、分销网络不足的新兴设计师难以获得曝光，使本土市场容易受到外国竞争冲击。Musinsa创始人赵文浩通过销售限量版运动鞋，甚至动用为大学学费预留的资金，维持网站运营。2005年，他将平台转型为在线时尚杂志，在物美价廉的替代选择寥寥无几之际，为新兴品牌提供推广渠道。D-Antidote、Liful和Critic等早期街头服饰品牌借助Musinsa的编辑内容积累忠实受众，为新一代独立品牌奠定基础，其中包括Covernat、Thisisneverthat、Matin Kim和Glowny，这些品牌后来均在韩国时尚界占据重要位置。2008年，Musinsa成功为全球时尚零售商Uniqlo位于光州中亭路的门店开业组织宣传活动，进一步展示其内容营销能力。此后，它扩大了与Adidas和New Balance等国际品牌的合作。内容代理业务的收入帮助Musinsa于2009年推出电商服务。2012年，Musinsa对加入平台的品牌采用寄售销售模式，加快自身成长为大型时尚零售商。随着独立设计师品牌通过Musinsa获得数百亿至数千亿韩元的年销售额，且无需经营自有实体店，线上与线下时尚零售商之间的力量格局开始转变。那些在平台上积累忠实客户群的品牌随后进驻百货商店青年时尚区的黄金地段，帮助重塑了曾由外国品牌主导的线下零售格局。Musinsa推动进口替代的关键因素之一，是其致力于建设帮助独立品牌经营和成长的基础设施，而非仅仅提供销售平台。2018年，公司在首尔东大门区推出以时尚为主题的共享办公空间Musinsa Studio，为小型品牌提供摄影棚、办公空间和包装区等必要设施。目前，该业务已扩展至5个地点，包括圣水、梨泰院和信达地区。自2015年以来，Musinsa还持续运营免息生产融资计划，帮助新兴品牌克服采购面料和下达季节系列生产订单时的资金短缺问题。过去10年，该计划累计提供超过4000亿韩元融资，帮助小型品牌管理现金流，并获得推出新系列所需的资金。2018年，Musinsa成立企业风险投资子公司Musinsa Partners，发掘并投资有望成长为时尚品牌的潜力企业，这些品牌过去往往难以吸引传统风险投资公司的关注。该投资部门迄今已向80多个品牌投资约1000亿韩元，包括Thisisneverthat、Covernat、Mardi Mercredi和Rockfish Weatherwear。Musinsa自有时尚品牌Musinsa Standard于2017年推出，以实用设计和有竞争力的价格对全球快时尚零售商形成挑战。该品牌已成为领先的本土快时尚品牌，直接与Uniqlo、Zara和H&M等国际企业竞争。预计其今年年销售额将达到7000亿韩元，明年接近1万亿韩元。Musinsa如今已不再满足于捍卫本土市场，而是积极推进海外扩张战略。Musinsa Global于2022年推出，旨在区别于主要依靠超低价格竞争的中国电商平台Shein和Temu，以及欧洲奢侈品时尚平台。公司 seeks to capitalize on the distinctive designs and quality of Korean independent labels while building an omnichannel ecosystem that connects its global logistics infrastructure, including Musinsa Fulfillment Services, with overseas pop-up stores. ipo进程于本月早些时候加速，预计将为Musinsa的全球扩张提供另一个主要资金来源。Musinsa估值预计在8万亿至10万亿韩元之间，计划将募集资金主要用于建设海外物流网络和扩大全球营销业务。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: German chancellor urges global trade alliance as Germany deepens Indo-Pacific ties
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Speaking at the opening of the 19th Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business (APK) in Seoul on Friday, Merz proposed establishing a "global political alliance for rules-based trade" to defend and strengthen the international trading system and coordinate joint action when it comes under threat.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Merz周五在首尔举行的第19届德国企业亚太会议（APK）开幕式上提议建立一个“基于规则的全球政治联盟”，以捍卫和加强国际贸易体系，并在该体系受到威胁时协调联合行动。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Speaking at the opening of the 19th Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business (APK) in Seoul on Friday, Merz proposed establishing a "global political alliance for rules-based trade" to defend and strengthen the international trading system and coordinate joint action when it comes under threat. “When supply chains become political pawns, when access to key technologies is imperiled or when efforts to secure raw materials become a projection of power rather than of fair partnership, this jeopardizes growth, prosperity and, ultimately, the security,” he said. “Countries that decouple lose security, innovative strength, prosperity and scope for action. We do not wish to withdraw but rather to expand our freedom of action.” Turning to bilateral ties, the chancellor said Germany and Korea had an opportunity to play a defining role together in countering unilateralism, economic coercion and violations of international law. He also highlighted the potential for deeper industrial cooperation between the two countries, welcoming a high-tech partnership framework that covers next-generation industries such as microelectronics, industrial artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics. “(The Korean-German high-tech framework agreement) sets the base for cooperation in next-generation industries such as microelectronics, industrial AI and robotics. It is a message to all of you that we are determined to shape our future,” he said. Korean Prime Minister Han Seong-sook emphasized the complementary strengths of the two economies during her keynote speech, describing Korea as a strategic bridge connecting Europe and the Asia-Pacific region. "In this regard, semiconductors are key to building global supply chains and innovation ecosystems and creating new industrial opportunities through cooperation,” she said, adding that the two countries are trusted partners that can strengthen their competitiveness by combining their respective strengths. “German precision technology is essential to the extreme ultraviolet lithography equipment used to produce cutting-edge semiconductors. Semiconductors produced in Korea using this technology are, in turn, used across various German industries, including the automotive sector.” Han identified batteries, semiconductors and the application of AI in manufacturing as three priority areas for bilateral cooperation. “If the industrial data and strengths of the two countries are closely connected, we can accelerate manufacturing innovation and jointly establish new industrial standards in the age of AI,” she said. At a subsequent panel discussion on shifting global power dynamics and their economic impact, Korea’s Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said Korea and Germany should work together to strengthen supply chain resilience while preserving the open trading system, warning against allowing economic security concerns to fuel protectionism. “We should not allow the pursuit of economic security to undermine the international economic order that has made our economies strong,” he said, adding that both countries, as manufacturing and export-oriented economies, shared an interest in maintaining open trade. “Korea and Germany have benefited enormously from open and rules-based international economic order … Now we have a shared responsibility to preserve and strengthen. We should not simply respond to change for change's sake, but should work together to shape it.” Siemens CEO Roland Busch, who chairs the Asia-Pacific Committee of German Business, identified industrial AI and energy technologies as major opportunities for cooperation, saying Germany and Asia could combine their manufacturing expertise, industrial data and technology to accelerate adoption. He said Korea's manufacturing capabilities and Europe's industrial strengths could create opportunities to scale new technologies across larger markets, but warned that the pace of technological change was becoming a major challenge. German State Secretary Stefan Rouenhoff said Berlin sought to diversify trade ties and reduce dependencies in critical raw materials, semiconductors and energy technologies. In a separate press statement, Busch outlined three priorities — innovation, investment and integration — calling for closer industrial AI cooperation, more investment flows and fewer trade barriers. Rouenhoff said the two countries would renew their energy partnership, focusing on energy security, power grids, storage and decarbonization. APK 2026, running from Friday through Saturday in Seoul, brings together about 800 business leaders and government officials from Germany and across the Asia-Pacific region to strengthen partnerships and advance economic cooperation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 德国总理在德国深化印太关系之际，呼吁建立全球贸易联盟
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 周五在首尔举行的第19届亚太德国商会大会（APK）开幕式上，默茨提议建立一个“基于规则的贸易全球政治联盟”，以维护和强化国际贸易体系，并在其受到威胁时协调联合行动。他说：“当供应链沦为政治棋子，当获取关键技术的渠道受到威胁，当确保原材料供应的努力变成力量投射而非公平伙伴关系时，增长、繁荣乃至安全都会受到危害。脱钩的国家会失去安全、创新实力、繁荣和行动空间。我们不希望收缩行动范围，而是希望扩大行动自由。”谈到双边关系时，这位总理表示，德国和韩国有机会携手发挥决定性作用，共同抵制单边主义、经济胁迫和违反国际法的行为。他还强调两国深化工业合作的潜力，并对涵盖微电子、工业人工智能（AI）和机器人等下一代产业的高科技合作框架表示欢迎。他说：“（韩德高科技框架协议）为微电子、工业AI和机器人等下一代产业合作奠定了基础。这向各位传递了一个信息：我们决心塑造我们的未来。”韩国总理韩升洙在主题演讲中强调两国经济的互补优势，称韩国是连接欧洲与亚太地区的战略桥梁。她说：“在这方面，芯片是构建全球供应链和创新生态体系，以及通过合作创造新产业机遇的关键。”她补充称，两国是值得信赖的伙伴，能够结合各自优势增强竞争力。“德国精密技术对于生产尖端芯片所使用的极紫外光刻设备至关重要。而韩国利用这项技术生产的芯片，反过来又应用于包括汽车业在内的德国各个行业。”韩升洙将电池、芯片以及人工智能在制造业中的应用列为双边合作的三大重点领域。她说：“如果两国的工业数据和优势紧密连接，我们就能够加快制造业创新，并在AI时代共同制定新的工业标准。”在随后关于全球权力格局变化及其经济影响的小组讨论中，韩国工业通商资源部长官金正官表示，韩国和德国应携手加强供应链韧性，同时维护开放贸易体系，并警告不要让经济安全担忧助长保护主义。他说：“我们不能让追求经济安全的努力，破坏使我们的经济保持强盛的国际经济秩序。”他补充说，作为制造业和出口导向型经济体，两国在维持开放贸易方面利益一致。“韩国和德国从开放、基于规则的国际经济秩序中受益良多……如今，我们肩负着维护和强化这一秩序的共同责任。我们不应只是为变而变，而应携手塑造变化。”担任德国商会亚太委员会主席的西门子首席执行官罗兰德·布希将工业AI和能源技术视为合作的主要机遇，称德国和亚洲可以结合制造业专长、工业数据和技术，加快技术应用。他说，韩国的制造能力和欧洲的工业优势可以创造机遇，让新技术在更大市场规模化应用，但警告技术变革的速度正成为一项重大挑战。德国国务秘书斯特凡·鲁嫩霍夫表示，柏林寻求实现贸易关系多元化，并减少对关键原材料、芯片和能源技术的依赖。在另一份新闻声明中，布希提出了创新、投资和融合三项重点，呼吁加强工业AI合作、增加投资流动并减少贸易壁垒。鲁嫩霍夫表示，两国将续签能源合作协议，重点关注能源安全、电网、储能和脱碳。APK 2026于周五至周六在首尔举行，汇集来自德国及亚太地区的大约800名商业领袖和政府官员，旨在加强伙伴关系、推动经济合作

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title: Goldman Sachs eyes Tmap Mobility acquisition by year-end
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary: The telecom operator spun off its mobility business into a separate company in December 2020, and Tmap Mobility became a subsidiary of SK Square the following year. Industry officials said Goldman Sachs appears to be betting on Tmap's extensive driving and location data accumulated over more than two decades. In addition, Tmap Mobility’s valuation has declined from previous levels amid delays to its initial public offering and growing competition, making it a more attractive investment target for Goldman Sachs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.summary_zh: 这家电信运营商于2020年12月将移动通信业务分拆为一家独立公司，次年Tmap Mobility成为SK Square的子公司。行业人士表示，Goldman Sachs似乎看中了Tmap在二十多年间积累的大量驾驶和位置数据。此外，由于首次公开募股延期以及竞争加剧，Tmap Mobility的估值较此前有所下降，使其成为对Goldman Sachs更具吸引力的投资目标。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: For SK Square, SK Group’s investment arm and the largest shareholder of SK hynix, the sale is part of a broader strategy to focus on artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors. The global investment bank is looking to invest between 600 billion won ($450 million) and 800 billion won to secure a 60 to 70 percent stake in Tmap Mobility. It is in talks to buy shares from SK Square, the largest shareholder with a 63.23 percent stake, as well as other financial investors, including Affirma Capital and EastBridge Partners, which each hold 9.83 percent, and KB Kookmin Bank, which owns 6.39 percent. Tmap Mobility traces its roots to a navigation service launched by SK Telecom in 2002. The telecom operator spun off its mobility business into a separate company in December 2020, and Tmap Mobility became a subsidiary of SK Square the following year. Its navigation app now has more than 15 million monthly active users, while the company’s offerings extend beyond smartphone navigation to AI-powered mobility solutions. Its navigation system is also integrated into vehicles from most major imported automakers in Korea, including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volvo and Tesla. Industry officials said Goldman Sachs appears to be betting on Tmap's extensive driving and location data accumulated over more than two decades. The data could become valuable as the mobility industry embraces AI and moves closer to autonomous driving. The data generated by the mobility platform's user base could help develop new AI-powered services and autonomous driving technologies. The U.S. investment bank appears to see value in Tmap's future growth prospects. Tmap Mobility recorded revenue of 283.5 billion won and an operating loss of 14.1 billion won last year, but posted its first annual net profit of 25 billion won. It also recorded its first monthly operating profit in June. These developments come amid Goldman Sachs' growing interest in Asia's mobility sector. In 2023, it invested 10 billion yen in GO, Japan's leading taxi-hailing platform. Earlier this year, Goldman also joined a VIG Partners-led consortium that explored acquiring a stake in Kakao Mobility, the operator of Korea's largest ride-hailing platform. The discussions, however, did not lead to a deal. "Goldman Sachs' interest in Asia's mobility market has grown rapidly, drawing on its expertise in IT and AI. An acquisition could give Tmap Mobility greater opportunities to develop new businesses and expand into overseas markets," an investment banking industry official said. In addition, Tmap Mobility’s valuation has declined from previous levels amid delays to its initial public offering and growing competition, making it a more attractive investment target for Goldman Sachs. SK Square, meanwhile, is expected to retain around a 10 percent stake in Tmap Mobility after the deal, remaining its second-largest shareholder and continuing to collaborate on AI and data services. "We are reviewing various options for Tmap Mobility's future growth and will provide details once they are finalized," an SK Square official said. The potential deal is also drawing attention from the investment banking industry, as it would mark Goldman Sachs' return to Korea's buyout market after nearly a decade. The bank's last major buyout in Korea was in 2016, when it acquired cosmetics maker Carver Korea alongside Bain Capital and kitchenware company Happycall with EastBridge Partners. It has since focused largely on minority investments, as it reorganized its private equity business and renewed its push into the Asia-Pacific market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.title_zh: 高盛寻求在年底前收购Tmap Mobility
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body_zh: 对于SK集团的投资部门、SK海力士的最大股东SK Square而言，此次出售是其专注于人工智能（AI）和半导体这一更广泛战略的一部分。这家全球投资银行计划投资6000亿韩元（4.5亿美元）至8000亿韩元，以获得Tmap Mobility 60%至70%的股份。它正在与SK Square（持有63.23%股份的最大股东）以及其他财务投资者进行谈判，包括各持有9.83%的Affirma Capital和EastBridge Partners，以及持有6.39%的KB国民银行。Tmap Mobility起源于SK Telecom于2002年推出的导航服务。这家电信运营商于2020年12月将其移动业务分拆为独立公司，次年Tmap Mobility成为SK Square的子公司。其导航应用目前拥有超过1500万月活跃用户，而该公司的业务已超越智能手机导航，扩展到人工智能驱动的移动解决方案。其导航系统还集成到韩国大多数主要进口汽车制造商的车辆中，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰、宝马、沃尔沃和特斯拉。行业官员表示，高盛似乎看好Tmap在过去二十多年积累的海量驾驶和位置数据。随着移动产业拥抱人工智能并向自动驾驶迈进，这些数据可能变得极具价值。移动平台用户群产生的数据有助于开发新的人工智能驱动服务和自动驾驶技术。这家美国投资银行似乎看到了Tmap未来增长前景的价值。Tmap Mobility去年录得营收2835亿韩元，营业亏损141亿韩元，但实现了首个年度净利润250亿韩元。它还在6月录得首个月度营业利润。这些进展正值高盛对亚洲移动领域兴趣日益增长之际。2023年，高盛向日本领先的叫车平台GO投资100亿日元。今年早些时候，高盛还加入了由VIG Partners牵头的财团，探讨收购韩国最大叫车平台运营商Kakao Mobility的股份。不过，这些讨论最终未能达成交易。“高盛对亚洲移动市场的兴趣迅速增长，依托其在IT和人工智能方面的专业知识。收购可能为Tmap Mobility提供更多开发新业务和拓展海外市场的机会，”一位投资银行业人士表示。此外，由于首次公开募股推迟以及竞争加剧，Tmap Mobility的估值已较此前水平有所下降，这使其成为高盛更具吸引力的投资目标。与此同时，SK Square预计将在交易完成后保留Tmap Mobility约10%的股份，继续作为第二大股东，并持续在人工智能和数据服务领域开展合作。“我们正在审视Tmap Mobility未来增长的各种选项，一旦确定将提供详细信息，”SK Square一位官员表示。这笔潜在交易也引起投资银行业的关注，因为它将标志着高盛在近十年后重返韩国的收购市场。该银行在韩国的最后一次重大收购发生在2016年，当时它与贝恩资本共同收购化妆品制造商Carver Korea，并与EastBridge Partners共同收购厨具公司Happycall。此后，它主要专注于少数股权投资，同时重组其私募股权业务，并重新发力亚太市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hanwha Systems has won a contract to develop synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites for Korea's microsatellite constellation aimed at enhancing national security and disaster response capabilities, data showed Friday. The defense solutions arm of Hanwha Group was selected for the SAR satellite development project commissioned by the state-run Agency for Defense Development (ADD), according to the Public Procurement Service.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩华系统公司获得了一份合同，为韩国旨在提升国家安全和灾害应对能力的微小卫星星座开发合成孔径雷达（SAR）卫星。据韩国公共采购局介绍，韩华集团的防务解决方案部门入选了由国有国防科学研究所（ADD）委托实施的SAR卫星开发项目。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hanwha Systems has won a contract to develop synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites for Korea's microsatellite constellation aimed at enhancing national security and disaster response capabilities, data showed Friday. The defense solutions arm of Hanwha Group was selected for the SAR satellite development project commissioned by the state-run Agency for Defense Development (ADD), according to the Public Procurement Service. The microsatellite development project is a joint initiative involving the defense ministry, the Korea AeroSpace Administration (KASA) and the Korea Coast Guard to strengthen surveillance of security threats and natural disasters on the Korean Peninsula and in surrounding waters. SAR satellites can capture images of land and sea regardless of weather conditions or time of day. Operating a constellation of small satellites allows for more frequent monitoring of specific areas and faster intelligence gathering. Hanwha Systems has previously supplied SAR sensors and data links for Korea's military reconnaissance satellites
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩华系统公司赢得SAR微小卫星星座项目
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国韩华系统公司获得了一份合同，将为韩国旨在提升国家安全和灾害响应能力的微小卫星星座开发合成孔径雷达（SAR）卫星。韩国采购厅表示，韩华集团旗下防务解决方案部门已被选中参与由国有国防科学研究所（ADD）委托实施的SAR卫星开发项目。据韩国采购厅介绍，这一微小卫星开发项目由韩国国防部、韩国宇宙航空厅（KASA）和韩国海岸警卫队联合推进，旨在加强对朝鲜半岛及周边海域安全威胁和自然灾害的监视。SAR卫星无论天气状况或昼夜时段均可拍摄陆地和海洋影像。运行由小型卫星组成的星座可提高对特定区域的监测频率，并加快情报收集速度。韩华系统公司此前曾为韩国军事侦察卫星提供SAR传感器和数据链路

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: LIG D&A faces growing hurdles in global arms export amid bribery scandal
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Potential ruling on 2-year bidding ban could disrupt defense manufacturing cycle LIG Defense & Aerospace's (LIG D&A) overseas expansion plans could be in jeopardy, as an ongoing bribery scandal threatens to disrupt its defense development and production pipeline through a potential two-year government bidding ban.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 针对两年禁止投标期限的潜在裁决可能扰乱国防制造周期。LIG Defense & Aerospace（LIG D&A）的海外扩张计划可能陷入危险，因为一场正在持续的贿赂丑闻有可能通过政府潜在的两年投标禁令，扰乱其国防研发和生产流程。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Potential ruling on 2-year bidding ban could disrupt defense manufacturing cycle LIG Defense & Aerospace's (LIG D&A) overseas expansion plans could be in jeopardy, as an ongoing bribery scandal threatens to disrupt its defense development and production pipeline through a potential two-year government bidding ban. The Seoul Administrative Court will hold a hearing on Thursday to review the company's request to suspend the enforcement of a two-year restriction imposed by the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA). Last week, the defense authority imposed the penalty on allegations that the firm’s executives offered bribes worth hundreds of millions of won to a DAPA employee during the bidding process for a weapons development project. LIG D&A denied the allegations and has taken legal steps for a temporary suspension of the penalty, which was originally scheduled to take effect on Thursday. The suspension will remain in place until Nov. 20. The potential disruption carries significant implications for the company's business structure. Its government and public institution clients accounted for 64.5 percent, or 2.78 trillion won ($2.07 billion), of LIG D&A's total sales last year. Although the restriction does not affect existing delivery contracts or overseas export agreements, a prolonged bidding ban could prevent the company from securing new development and production contracts. This could disrupt the pipeline of future defense programs, with potential consequences for production planning, investment and its ability to expand its export business. The timing is particularly challenging, as LIG D&A is expected to compete for major upcoming defense projects, including a next-generation combat unmanned surface vessel program. For a defense contractor seeking to expand its international footprint, losing access to new domestic procurement projects could also weaken its position in overseas markets. Domestic defense contracts often provide opportunities to develop and validate weapons systems before pursuing larger export orders. “Reduced access to new programs could consequently limit the company's ability to build its future product portfolio and secure additional overseas sales,” an official from the defense industry said. “The immediate priority for LIG D&A is to maintain its bidding eligibility while contesting the sanction.” However, even if the company secures a temporary reprieve, the legal dispute will not end immediately, so it will still remain a source of uncertainty for its future projects and global expansion strategy. LIG D&A shares have been on a steep decline over the past month due to the bribery scandal. The stock price of the firm reached a one-month high of 773,000 won on Oct. 6, but has since dropped by around 40 percent to trade around 410,000 won as of Friday. Brokerage houses are also on track to downgrade the stock price for the company. Daishin Securities and Hyundai Motor Securities lowered their target prices for LIG D&A to 830,000 won from 990,000 won and 925,000 won from 1.32 million won, respectively
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 受贿赂丑闻影响，LIG D&A在全球武器出口方面面临日益增多的障碍
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 针对2年投标禁令的裁决可能扰乱国防制造业周期。LIG D&A的海外扩张计划可能面临风险，因为一桩正在审理的贿赂丑闻可能令其国防研发与生产流程遭受干扰，政府有可能实施2年投标禁令。首尔行政法院将于星期四举行听证，审查该公司提出的中止执行国防事业厅对其实施2年限制的请求。上周，国防主管部门以该公司高管涉嫌在武器研发项目竞标过程中向国防事业厅工作人员提供价值数亿韩元的贿赂为由，对其实施了处罚。LIG D&A否认了相关指控，并已采取法律措施申请暂时中止执行该处罚。处罚原定于星期四生效，中止执行将持续至11月20日。这一潜在干扰将对公司的业务结构产生重大影响。去年，政府和公共机构客户为LIG D&A贡献了总销售额的64.5%，即2.78万亿韩元（20.7亿美元）。尽管该限制不影响现有交付合同或海外出口协议，但长期投标禁令可能使公司无法获得新的研发和生产合同，从而扰乱未来国防项目储备，并可能影响其生产计划、投资以及扩大出口业务的能力。当前时点尤其具有挑战性，因为LIG D&A预计将参与竞逐多个即将启动的重大国防项目，其中包括下一代作战无人水面舰艇项目。对于寻求扩大国际业务版图的国防承包商而言，失去参与新国内采购项目的机会，也可能削弱其在海外市场的地位。国内国防合同通常可提供研发和验证武器系统的机会，之后企业再争取规模更大的出口订单。国防工业一名官员表示：“获得新项目的机会减少，可能因此限制公司构建未来产品组合和扩大海外销售的能力。LIG D&A当前的首要任务是，在对处罚提出异议的同时维持其投标资格。”不过，即使公司获得暂时缓冲，这场法律争议也不会立即结束，因此仍将是其未来项目和全球扩张战略的不确定因素。受贿赂丑闻影响，LIG D&A股价过去一个月大幅下跌。该公司股价10月6日升至一个月高点773,000韩元，此后下跌约40%，截至星期五报收于410,000韩元左右。多家券商也预计将下调该公司的目标价。大信证券和现代汽车证券分别将LIG D&A目标价从990,000韩元和132万韩元下调至830,000韩元和925,000韩元。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.title: Seoul AI Foundation, robot agency team up on physical AI services
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary: The Seoul AI Foundation has signed an agreement with the state-run Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement (KIRIA) to develop joint projects that combine artificial intelligence and robotics to address the city’s needs, the foundation said Friday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.summary_zh: 首尔人工智能基金会周五宣布，已与国有韩国机器人产业振兴院签署协议，将开展融合人工智能与机器技术的联合项目，以满足首尔市的实际需求。该基金会是由市政府提供资金、负责制定首尔人工智能政策并开发相关服务的机构。基金会表示，双方的合作将从首尔面临的城市实际问题及市民需求出发，而不是从现有技术出发。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: The Seoul AI Foundation has signed an agreement with the state-run Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement (KIRIA) to develop joint projects that combine artificial intelligence and robotics to address the city’s needs, the foundation said Friday. The memorandum of understanding was signed Oct. 7 at Smart Life Week 2026, an artificial intelligence (AI) and smart city exhibition hosted by the Seoul Metropolitan Government at Coex in southern Seoul. She learned how to set up a Claude Code environment, connect it to email, calendars and collaboration and document management tools, and automate repetitive tasks. The class had around a dozen office workers, and the atmosphere was “reminiscent of a high school senior classroom,” Lim said. She uses AI not only to research marketing cases, compare materials and draft reports, but also to retrieve records of past projects and identify problems during service planning. AI is involved in “70 to 80 percent” of her work, she said. As more companies encourage employees to use AI, a growing number of workers are paying out of pocket to learn how to use the technology. They see AI training as a new form of self-development. Shin, 30, who took the course despite not using Claude Code at work, said the money was “an investment worth making” because the skills could come in handy when taking on new responsibilities or changing jobs. The perception of AI proficiency as a key workplace skill is spreading rapidly. Although the scores are not part of formal personnel evaluations, she sometimes uses AI to rewrite even simple emails. “I feel like I shouldn’t be dragging down my department’s average,” she said. A study by Kim Dong-gyu, a research fellow at the Korea Employment Information Service, surveyed 305 workers in IT development, design and office administration and found both positive and negative emotions surrounding AI use. Among positive responses, a sense of achievement from producing satisfactory results was the most common, at 57.4 percent. Among negative responses, the most frequently cited was the burden of learning new technology, at 52.1 percent. Oh, 37, said she feels pressured when her company tells employees that learning AI would be beneficial. “If a company expects employees to use AI, it should also provide training and cover the costs,” she said. In Kim’s study, providing education and training was the most frequently cited organizational response to the spread of AI, selected by 41.3 percent of respondents. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 40岁的Lim是一家大型企业的市场营销人员，最近六/seven日都在首尔瑞草区参加由一位知名讲师教授的Claude Code课程。Claude Code是美国Anthropic开发的人工智能（AI）编程智能体。她学习了如何设置Claude Code环境，将其连接到电子邮件、日历以及协作和文档管理工具，并自动完成重复性任务。Lim说，课程约有十多名办公室职员参加，现场氛围“让人想起高中高年级教室”。据报道，在这为期两天、每天九小时的课程中，学员即使在休息时间也通常留在座位上。Lim为这门课程支付了100万韩元（$700）。尽管价格不菲，她表示这笔钱花得值得。当她看到同事们越来越熟练地使用AI时，她感到了一种错失恐惧，担心自己正在落后。Lim目前正在工作中应用所学内容。她不仅使用AI研究营销案例、比较材料和起草报告，还用它检索过往项目的记录，并找出服务规划中的问题。她说，AI参与了她“70%至80%”的工作。随着更多公司鼓励员工使用AI，越来越多劳动者开始自费学习如何使用这项技术。他们将AI培训视为一种新的自我发展方式。30岁的Shin虽然工作中并未使用Claude Code，但也参加了这门课程。她说，这笔钱是“一项值得进行的投资”，因为在承担新职责或转换工作时，这些技能可能派上用场。将AI熟练程度视为关键职场技能的看法正在迅速传播。Google委托英国咨询公司Public First开展的一项针对1,057名韩国成年人的近期调查发现，74%的人有意参加AI技能培训。在有工作的受访者中，82%预计在未来五年内，AI技能会变得对其工作重要。不过，并非所有员工都完全出于自愿使用AI。在一家外国公司工作的38岁Hwang说，她的雇主每周公布个人和部门的AI使用评分。尽管这些评分不属于正式的人事考核，她有时仍会使用AI重写内容最简单的邮件。“我觉得自己不应该拉低部门的平均分，”她说。韩国雇佣信息服务公司研究员Kim Dong-gyu开展的一项研究调查了IT开发、设计和办公室行政领域的305名劳动者，发现围绕AI使用的情绪既有积极面，也有消极面。在积极反馈中，从产出满意成果中获得成就感最为普遍，占57.4%。在消极反馈中，最常被提及的是学习新技术的负担，占52.1%。37岁的Oh说，当公司告诉员工学习AI会有好处时，她会感到压力。“如果公司期待员工使用AI，就也应该提供培训并承担费用，”她说。在Kim的研究中，提供教育和培训是针对AI普及最常被提及的组织应对措施，41.3%的受访者选择了这一项。研究结果表明，许多劳动者希望公司为AI教育和实践培训提供制度性支持，而不是任由员工自行培养相关技能。本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹刊物《韩国先驱报》，由生成式AI系统翻译，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Korean comic creators called for strict rules requiring artists' consent before their work is used to train artificial intelligence (AI) models, delivering their demand Friday during an international conference at UNESCO headquarters in Paris. Webtoons are digital comics designed to be read by scrolling on smartphones. They are a major Korean cultural export, and many have been adapted into TV dramas and films. Kwon appeared on a panel about developing AI systems that respect rights and cultural diversity. Alexandra Bensamoun, a professor at Paris-Saclay University, chaired the session, which also included representatives of the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry and Microsoft. Kwon cited a survey the association conducted. Of the 164 creators who responded, about 90 percent said they did not know how to stop their work from being used for AI training. Meanwhile, 81.1 percent said they would take part in an opt-in system, under which their work could be used only with their prior consent. He said that allowing a webtoon to be published, allowing it to be used to train an AI model and allowing its characters to be used in AI services such as chatbots are separate rights. Creators should be able to decide on each one, he said. He also called for mandatory labeling of AI-generated content and transparency about training data. At the conference, Jean-Michel Jarre, the electronic music composer and UNESCO Goodwill Ambassador, said humans must remain the ones who decide the purpose and direction of creative work. Ángeles González-Sinde, vice president of the International Confederation of Societies of Authors and Composers, called for meaningful consent rights, transparency about training data and fair pay for creators. UNESCO said the discussions will feed into its digital policy work under the 2005 Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions, according to the association. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh: 韩国漫画创作者呼吁制定严格规定，要求在艺术家同意后才能使用其作品训练人工智能模型。创作者于周五在巴黎联合国教科文组织总部举行的一次国际会议上提出这一诉求。网络漫画是设计为通过智能手机上下滑动阅读的数字漫画。它们是韩国重要的文化出口产品，许多已被改编为电视剧和电影。权先生出席了一个关于开发尊重权利和文化多样性的人工智能系统的小组讨论。Paris-Saclay University教授Alexandra Bensamoun主持了这场讨论，出席者还包括国际唱片业协会和Microsoft的代表。权先生援引了该协会开展的一项调查。在作出回应的164名创作者中，约90 percent表示他们不知道如何阻止自己的作品被用于人工智能训练。与此同时，81.1 percent表示愿意参加自愿加入制度；根据该制度，只有事先获得创作者同意，其作品才能被使用。他说，允许网络漫画出版、允许将其用于训练人工智能模型，以及允许在聊天机器人等人工智能服务中使用其角色，分别属于不同的权利。创作者应能够就每一项权利自行作出决定。他还呼吁强制标注人工智能生成的内容，并提高训练数据的透明度。在这次会议上，电子音乐作曲家和联合国教科文组织亲善大使Jean-Michel Jarre表示，决定创作目的和方向的权利必须始终掌握在人类手中。国际作者和作曲者协会联合会副主席Ángeles González-Sinde呼吁赋予创作者有意义的同意权、提高训练数据透明度，并向创作者支付公平报酬。据该协会介绍，联合国教科文组织表示，这些讨论将为其依据《保护并促进文化表现形式多样性公约》（2005年）开展的数字政策工作提供参考。本文在生成式人工智能协助下发布，由The Korea Times编辑

https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.summary_zh: 这项努力的核心是扩大对专项4000万美元“石油与天然气女性基金”的准入，确保更多女性拥有的企业和专业人士能够受益于行业机会，并在整个行业价值链中发挥更重要的作用。2021年4月，尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会设立了一笔2000万美元的专项基金，用于支持石油和天然气行业由女性拥有及女性领导的企业。
https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.body: Central to this effort is expanding access to the dedicated $40 million Women in Oil and Gas Fund, ensuring that more women-owned businesses and professionals benefit from industry’s opportunities and play a stronger role across the sector’s value chain. In April 2021, the NCDMB established a $20 million fund dedicated to supporting women-owned and women-led businesses in the oil and gas sector. The Nigerian Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) complemented this effort by matching the fund with an additional $20 million. However, despite this significant commitment and favorable loan terms, the uptake of the scheme has remained below expectations to date. On Thursday, UN Women’s Country Representative to Nigeria and the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), Ms. Beatrice Eyong, led a delegation to the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board’s (NCDMB) Abuja liaison office. The team was received by the Board’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, on behalf of the Executive Secretary, Engr. Felix Omatsola Ogbe. The meeting explored proposed capacity-building initiatives for NCDMB personnel, aimed at mainstreaming gender perspectives into the Board’s project planning, budgeting, and execution frameworks. Other key areas of discussion included vendor development schemes to better position women-led oil and gas businesses for industry opportunities, strategies to raise awareness of available financing options, and potential affirmative procurement measures designed to expand the participation of women-owned companies across the oil and gas value chain. The UN official commended NCDMB for its ongoing gender inclusion efforts, noting that the Board is already implementing several measures consistent with its mandate. She proposed conducting a study to identify the reasons women face challenges in accessing the financing facility, including potential barriers related to documentation, business registration, tax compliance, and limited awareness. She further highlighted key initiatives currently being undertaken by the UN Office, such as programs on women’s economic empowerment, leadership development, and the elimination of gender-based violence, among others. NCDMB’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, welcomed the proposals and affirmed the Board’s readiness to partner with UN Women. He highlighted several innovative initiatives already implemented by the Board to create opportunities for women to participate, grow, and lead in Nigeria’s oil and gas industry. These include the establishment of a dedicated funding scheme with NEXIM Bank that enables women-owned or women-led firms to access financing at a highly competitive 5% interest rate, as well as the creation of a Diversity Sectoral Working Group within the Nigerian Content Consultative Forum (NCCF), designed to mainstream women’s issues into local content policy and decision-making processes. The Board also supports associations of women who work across the Energy Industry value chain, where they network, build confidence and links to progress their careers or businesses. Dr. Ezeobi noted that NCDMB has also invested significantly in capacity-building programs for women entrepreneurs and business leaders, covering critical areas such as business sustainability, corporate governance, and strategic management. The Board has further supported women’s participation in technical occupations while encouraging young girls to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). He acknowledged that women remain underrepresented in the oil and gas industry, citing limited access to technical education, finance, and commercial opportunities, as well as entrenched perceptions of the sector as predominantly male. Dr. Ezeobi reaffirmed NCDMB’s willingness to collaborate with UN Women to address these challenges and recommended strategies to accelerate the Board’s support for UN Women’s programmes, thereby advancing gender inclusion across the industry. https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.body_zh: 这项努力的核心，是扩大专门面向女性石油与天然气行业的4000万美元基金的可及性，确保更多女性拥有的企业和专业人士能够从行业机遇中受益，并在整个行业价值链中发挥更重要的作用。2021年4月，NCDMB设立了一项2000万美元的专项基金，用于支持石油与天然气行业中的女性所有企业和女性领导企业。尼日利亚进出口银行（NEXIM）通过追加2000万美元资金，与该基金形成配套，为这项努力提供支持。然而，尽管做出了这一重大承诺并提供了优惠贷款条件，该计划迄今的使用率仍低于预期。周四，联合国妇女署驻尼日利亚及西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）国别代表Beatrice Eyong女士率领代表团前往尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会（NCDMB）阿布贾联络办公室。该委员会企业传播总经理Obinna Ezeobi博士代表执行秘书Felix Omatsola Ogbe工程师接待了来访团队。会议探讨了为NCDMB人员制定能力建设方案的 proposed aiming to mainstream gender perspectives into the Board’s project planning, budgeting, and execution frameworks。其他重点讨论领域包括：通过供应商发展计划，进一步提升女性领导的石油与天然气企业把握行业机遇的能力；制定提高对可用融资选项认识度的策略；以及研究实施肯定性采购措施，以扩大女性所有企业在石油与天然气价值链中的参与。该联合国官员赞扬了NCDMB持续推动性别包容的努力，并指出，该委员会正在实施多项符合其职责要求的措施。她提议开展一项研究，查明女性在获取融资方面面临困难的原因，包括文件准备、企业注册、税务合规和认知有限等潜在障碍。她还强调，联合国办公室目前正在开展多项重点行动，包括促进女性经济赋权、培养领导力和消除基于性别的暴力等方案。NCDMB企业传播总经理Obinna Ezeobi博士对这些提议表示欢迎，并确认该委员会已准备与联合国妇女署合作。他介绍了委员会已经实施的若干创新举措，旨在为女性参与、发展并在尼日利亚石油与天然气行业发挥领导作用创造机会。这些举措包括与NEXIM银行设立专项融资计划，使女性所有或女性领导的企业能够以极具竞争力的5%利率获得融资；以及在尼日利亚本地内容咨询论坛（NCCF）内设立多元化部门工作组，将女性议题纳入本地内容政策和决策进程。委员会还支持在能源行业价值链各领域工作的女性协会，使女性能够拓展人际网络、建立信心和联系，进而推动职业或企业发展。Ezeobi博士指出，NCDMB还在女性创业者和商业领袖的能力建设项目中投入了大量资金，涵盖企业可持续性、公司治理和战略管理等关键领域。该委员会还支持女性参与技术职业，同时鼓励年轻女孩投身科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）领域。他承认，女性的代表性在石油与天然气行业仍然不足，原因包括获取技术教育、金融和商业机会的渠道有限，以及该行业主要由男性主导这一根深蒂固的观念。Ezeobi博士重申，NCDMB愿意与联合国妇女署合作应对这些挑战，并建议采取相关策略，加快该委员会对联合国妇女署项目的支持，从而推动整个行业的性别包容。掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Dangote Cement reported a 31.2 per cent surge in net profit for the nine months to September, compared to the same period last year, driven by a considerable increase in sales, according to the latest corporate results of Sub-Saharan Africa’s biggest cement maker. The corporation posted a 19.6 per cent rise in turnover, which climbed to N3.8 trillion, boosted by improved revenue from the sales of cement and clinker. Nigeria, its primary market, accounted for 70.8 per cent of total sales, while its pan-African operations contributed the rest. Dangote Cement, with a production capacity of 55 million tonnes per annum, has footprints in 11 African countries, including Cameroon, Ethiopia, Zambia, Tanzania, Cote d’Ivoire among others. Cost of sales as a proportion of revenue declined to 36.8 per cent from 40.8 per cent, softening the impact of cost pressures on gross profit. Administrative expenses advanced by 11.7 per cent to N226.1 billion, while selling and distribution expenses jumped by 23.6 per cent to N618.9 billion, the latter driven by higher haulage costs. Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortisation (EBITDA), a key indicator which measures the core operating profit of a business, stood at N1.8 trillion, up from N1.4 trillion a year ago. That puts EBITDA’s margin at 46.8 per cent, compared to 45.3 per cent in the same period of last year. Strengthening profit, the company cut back finance costs to N120.8 billion from N286 billion, following a sharp reduction in interest expenses. Profit before tax was up by 41.5 per cent at N1.5 trillion, while profit after tax advanced to N974.8 billion from N743.3 billion. Total assets stood at N6.2 trillion, relative to N6 trillion as of the end of last year. Dangote Cement is on track to complete a cross-border listing on the London Stock Exchange in addition to a primary listing in Lagos, where its market capitalisation stood at N22.6 trillion at the open of trading on Wednesday. The company added Goldman Sachs and UBS Group AG as bookrunners for the listing, which is planned for November, according to a Bloomberg report earlier this month. If plans work out, it will be quoted under the international commercial companies secondary listing framework, the company said in May. Last month, FTSE Russell named Dangote Cement among the ten Nigerian companies it added to its Frontier Index Series
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: 丹格特水泥九个月利润增长31%，营收达到3.8万亿奈拉
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 据这家撒哈拉以南非洲最大水泥制造商的最新企业业绩，丹格特水泥截至9月的9个月净利润同比飙升31.2%，主要得益于销售额大幅增长。公司营业额增长19.6%，升至3.8万亿奈拉，水泥和熟料销售收入增加进一步推高了营业额。其主要市场尼日利亚占总销售额的70.8%，其余销售额来自其泛非洲业务。丹格特水泥年产能为5500万吨，业务遍及喀麦隆、埃塞俄比亚、赞比亚、坦桑尼亚、科特迪瓦等11个非洲国家。销售成本占收入的比重从40.8%降至36.8%，缓解了成本压力对毛利润的影响。行政费用增长11.7%，达到2261亿奈拉；销售及分销费用则因运输成本上升而跃升23.6%，达到6189亿奈拉。息税折旧摊销前利润（EBITDA）是衡量企业核心经营利润的关键指标，该指标达到1.8万亿奈拉，高于去年同期的1.4万亿奈拉。这使EBITDA利润率从去年同期的45.3%升至46.8%。随着利润增强，公司在利息支出大幅减少后，将融资成本从2860亿奈拉削减至1208亿奈拉。税前利润增长41.5%，达到1.5万亿奈拉；税后利润从7433亿奈拉增至9748亿奈拉。总资产为6.2万亿奈拉，而去年年底为6万亿奈拉。除在拉各斯主要上市外，丹格特水泥还计划在伦敦证券交易所完成跨境上市。周三开盘时，该公司在拉各斯的市值为22.6万亿奈拉。据彭博本月早些时候报道，公司已聘请高盛和UBS Group AG担任此次上市的簿记管理人，上市计划于11月进行。公司5月表示，若各项计划顺利落实，其股票将根据国际商业公司二级上市框架挂牌交易。上个月，FTSE Russell将丹格特水泥列入其前沿指数系列新增的10家尼日利亚公司之中……

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.body: The Ghana Medical Trust Fund (GMTF) is seeking partnerships with American hospitals, investors and philanthropists to expand cancer treatment and other specialist healthcare services in Ghana. The Fund’s Administrator, Adjoa Obuobia Darko-Opoku, made the appeal at the Ghana-Tennessee Business and Investor Roundtable in Nashville, Tennessee. She said partnerships could help close gaps in diagnostics, treatment, specialist training, and hospital infrastructure while easing patients' financial burden. “For many families, a diagnosis is difficult enough. But the next question is often even more frightening: how are we going to afford the treatment, and where can we access this care?” she said. Ms Darko-Opoku said the Fund had enrolled more than 800 patients for treatment under its services package. It covers 13 common cancers, neurosurgical conditions, cardiovascular diseases and kidney diseases. Outlining the Fund’s work, she said it had reconstructed the cardiac catheterisation laboratory at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital after a fire disrupted services. According to her, the facility has supported more than 160 procedures since it was commissioned, including 110 involving children. She said oncology centres were under construction at Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital in Kumasi and Tamale Teaching Hospital. The Fund is also working with the KGL Group on a proposed $10 million diagnostic and imaging centre at Ridge Hospital. The project aims to improve access to MRI, CT scans, and mammography. Plans are also underway for an advanced comprehensive oncology centre at Korle Bu to ease pressure on existing facilities and reduce waiting times. Ms Darko-Opoku said the Fund was investing close to GH¢1 billion in medical equipment for major hospitals. These include dialysis machines, intensive care beds, oxygen concentrators and patient monitors. To address workforce shortages, the Fund is sponsoring the training of 100 specialist pharmacists and 100 specialist nurses. It is also supporting specialist medical training centres in six regions. She identified infrastructure, medical technology, specialist training, research and financial assistance for vulnerable patients as priority areas for US partnerships. The Fund is also exploring adding treatments such as kidney transplantation to its services package. Ms Darko-Opoku said government resources alone could not meet Ghana’s growing specialist healthcare needs. She urged American institutions and the Ghanaian diaspora to commit to specific projects with clear implementation plans and measurable outcomes. “We are open to partnerships that bring together investment, technical expertise and a shared commitment to results,” she said. Potential support could include diagnostic equipment, clinical exchanges, cancer care facilities, research funding and treatment assistance for patients who cannot afford care. “What we have achieved so far shows what is possible. With the right partnerships, we can do much more,” she said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.title_zh: 加纳医疗信托基金争取美国合作伙伴，扩大癌症医疗服务
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ghana-medica.body_zh: 加纳医疗信托基金（GMTF）正寻求与美国医院、投资者和慈善家建立合作关系，以扩大加纳的癌症治疗及其他专科医疗服务。该基金管理员阿乔阿·奥博比亚·达尔科-奥波库在田纳西州纳什维尔举行的“加纳—田纳西商业与投资者圆桌会议”上提出这一倡议。她说，合作有助于弥合诊断、治疗、专科培训和医院基础设施等方面的缺口，同时减轻患者的经济负担。她说：“对许多家庭而言，确诊本身已经足够艰难。但接下来的问题往往更加令人恐惧：我们如何负担治疗费用，又能在哪里获得这种医疗服务？”达尔科-奥波库女士表示，该基金已根据其服务套餐安排800多名患者接受治疗。服务范围涵盖13种常见癌症、神经外科疾病、心血管疾病和肾脏疾病。她在介绍该基金的工作时说，Korle Bu教学医院心导管实验室因火灾中断服务后，基金对其进行了重建。据她介绍，该设施投入运行以来已支持160多台手术，其中110台涉及儿童。她说，库马西Komfo Anokye教学医院和塔马利教学医院的肿瘤中心正在建设之中。该基金还正与KGL集团合作，拟在Ridge Hospital建设一座价值1000万美元的诊断和影像中心。该项目旨在改善患者接受MRI、CT扫描和乳腺摄影检查的机会。Korle Bu还在规划建设一座先进的综合肿瘤中心，以缓解现有设施的压力并缩短等待时间。达尔科-奥波库女士表示，该基金正投入近10亿加纳塞地，为大型医院采购医疗设备，包括透析机、重症监护床、制氧机和患者监护仪。为应对医疗人才短缺，该基金正资助100名专科药师和100名专科护士接受培训，并支持在6个地区建设专科医疗培训中心。她将基础设施、医疗技术、专科培训、研究以及为弱势患者提供财务援助列为与美国合作的重点领域。该基金还在研究将肾移植等治疗项目纳入其服务套餐。达尔科-奥波库女士表示，仅靠政府资源无法满足加纳不断增长的专科医疗需求。她敦促美国机构和加侨投身于具有明确实施计划和可衡量成果的具体项目。她说：“我们欢迎将投资、技术专长和共同追求成效的承诺结合起来的合作关系。”潜在支持可包括提供诊断设备、推动临床交流、建设癌症护理设施、资助研究，以及帮助无力承担治疗费用的患者。“我们迄今取得的成就表明了可能性。有了合适的合作关系，我们能够做得更多。”她说。

https://www.lesahel.org/diplomatie-celeb.body: Dans le cadre de la célébration du 103ème anniversaire de la République de Türkiye, l’ambassade de Türkiye au Niger a organisé une réception, dans l’après-midi du jeudi 29 octobre 2026, à l’hôtel Radisson Blu de Niamey. Au cours de l’évènement, l’ambassadeur de Türkiye au Niger SE. Özgür ARSLAN a réaffirmé l’excellence des relations bilatérales entre la Türkiye et le Niger. Cette commémoration a été marquée par une forte charge symbolique avec l’exécution successive des hymnes nationaux du Niger, de la Türkiye et de l’Alliance des États du Sahel (AES). Dans son allocution, SE. Özgür ARSLAN a exprimé sa profonde gratitude envers les autorités et le peuple nigériens pour leur présence massive. Il a rappelé que la Politique d’Ouverture sur l’Afrique, portée par le Président Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ne s’embarrasse d’aucun paternalisme. Elle repose strictement sur les piliers de la solidarité, du bénéfice mutuel et du respect rigoureux de la souveraineté des États. C’est fidèle à ces principes directeurs que le Niger et la Türkiye ont vu leurs liens se consolider de manière spectaculaire ces dernières années. Le diplomate turc a énuméré les secteurs clés de cette coopération dynamique, citant notamment la défense, la santé, l’éducation, l’énergie, les mines, la formation professionnelle, l’action humanitaire et le tourisme. Cette commémoration intervient alors que l’axe Türkiye-Niger connaît une intensification sans précédent de ses contacts au plus haut niveau. L’ambassadeur a tenu à retracer la trajectoire de cette synergie, citant la visite en Türkiye du Premier ministre nigérien, SE. Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine en 2024, suivie le mois suivant par la venue à Niamey d’une délégation de haut rang comprenant les ministres turcs des Affaires étrangères, de la Défense, et du vice-ministre du Commerce. https://www.myjoyonline.com/a-call-for-s.summary_zh: 新爱国党（NPP）以及一些被认为同情该党的媒体对沃尔塔地区部长们持续不断的攻击日益令人担忧。在我看来，我们正在目睹一种蓄意而不幸的模式：有人企图削弱沃尔塔地区一些杰出政治领袖的公信力、正直品格和贡献。我呼吁沃尔塔地区的全国民主大会党（NDC），特别是充满活力的青年翼，坚定立场，与我们的部长们团结一致。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/a-call-for-s.body: The incessant attacks on Ministers from the Volta Region by the New Patriotic Party (NPP) and sections of the media perceived as sympathetic to it are increasingly worrying. In my view, we are witnessing a deliberate and unfortunate pattern of attempts to undermine the credibility, integrity, and contributions of some of the Volta Region’s finest political leaders. From Abla Dzifa Gomashie to Kwame Agbodza, and now Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, the recurring attacks raise legitimate questions about the motivations behind these campaigns. Political accountability and constructive criticism are essential ingredients of our democracy. However, there is a clear distinction between holding public officials accountable and engaging in sustained personal attacks and unsubstantiated allegations intended to damage their reputations and distract from their responsibilities. Our Ministers deserve to be assessed fairly on their performance, decisions and contributions to national development, rather than being subjected to what appears to be a coordinated campaign of political vilification. I call on the NDC in the Volta Region, particularly our vibrant Youth Wing, to stand firm in solidarity with our Ministers. We must remain vigilant, united and resolute in defending their integrity against unfounded allegations and politically motivated attacks, while continuing to uphold the principles of transparency and accountability. The Volta Region has contributed immensely to the NDC's political fortunes and Ghana's development. We must never allow partisan attacks to diminish the contributions of our distinguished representatives in government. We must stand together, speak with one voice and defend our own when they are unfairly targeted. An attack on the reputation of one of our leaders without credible justification deserves a collective, principled response

https://leadership.ng/turnah-denies-rece.summary_zh: 图纳表示，在前总统任职的六年间，无论是以他本人的名义，还是通过其他代表他行事的人，他都没有从乔纳森政府获得任何合同。他说：“在古德勒克·乔纳森博士执政的六年间，我没有从他的政府获得任何合同，无论是以我的名义，还是以任何代表我行事之人的名义。”
https://leadership.ng/turnah-denies-rece.body: Turnah said he did not receive any contract from the Jonathan administration during the former president’s six years in office, either in his name or through another person acting on his behalf. He made the statement in Yenagoa during the PDP State Executive Committee meeting, where he defended his record in public service and accused some individuals of trying to damage his reputation. “Throughout the six years of Dr Goodluck Jonathan’s administration, I did not receive any contract from his government, not in my name, not in the name of anybody on my behalf,” he said. He challenged anyone who served in the Presidency, ministries, departments or agencies during the period to produce evidence that he received a contract. Turnah also denied allegations that he received money to build Ogbia community but diverted the funds, describing the claims as false rumours. He said his record as a former special assistant on youth development at the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) should be assessed based on his contributions rather than unverified allegations. The PDP chairman also challenged anyone claiming that he had been convicted of money laundering, obtaining money by false pretence, forgery or conspiracy to produce the relevant court records. He said although he had faced prosecution over allegations relating to those offences, anyone claiming that he was convicted should provide evidence to support the claim. “I do not fear death, and I know that my life is in God’s hands. I will continue to speak truth to power at all times,” Turnah said. He accused some individuals of using social media to attack his reputation, insisting that the criticism would not distract him from his role as an opposition leader. Turnah said he remained committed to holding the Bayelsa State Government accountable and rebuilding the PDP into a party capable of addressing poverty and improving the lives of residents. The PDP chairman also criticised the state government’s spending on the celebration of Bayelsa’s 30th anniversary, demanding that Governor Douye Diri’s administration publish a detailed account of the expenditure. He called on the government to disclose the total amount spent and identify the budgetary provision that authorised the celebration. Turnah said the government should apologise to Bayelsans if it was established that public funds had been misused. He argued that the anniversary celebration should not take priority over the difficulties facing residents, including hunger, the inability of some parents to pay school fees, shortages of drugs in hospitals and poor road conditions. The PDP chairman further accused the Bayelsa State House of Assembly of failing to provide effective oversight of government spending. However, the claims concerning the anniversary expenditure and the allegations against Turnah were not independently established in the information available for this report. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/turnah-denies-rece.body_zh: 图纳表示，在前总统任职的6年间，无论是以他本人的名义，还是通过他人代他行事，他都没有从乔纳森政府获得任何合同。他是在叶纳戈阿举行的 PDP 州执行委员会会议上作出上述表态的。会上，他为自己的公共服务履历辩护，并指控一些人试图损害他的声誉。图纳说：“在古德勒克·乔纳森博士执政的6年里，我没有从他的政府获得任何合同，既不是以我的名义，也不是以任何代表我的人的名义。”他要求在此期间曾在总统府、各部委、部门或机构任职的人拿出证据，证明他曾获得合同。图纳还否认了有关他收取资金建设奥格比亚社区却侵吞资金的指控，称这些说法是虚假谣言。他说，人们应当根据他对尼日尔河三角洲发展委员会（NDDC）工作的贡献，而不是未经核实的指控来评价他担任青年发展特别助理期间的履历。这名 PDP 主席还要求任何声称他曾因洗钱、以虚假借口获取钱财、伪造或共谋而被定罪的人拿出相关法院记录。他说，尽管他曾因涉及这些罪行的指控而面临起诉，但任何声称他已被定罪的人都应提供证据支持这一说法。图纳说：“我不惧死亡，也知道自己的生命掌握在上帝手中。我将始终向权力说出真相。”他指控一些利用社交媒体攻击其声誉的人，并坚称这些批评不会使他偏离反对派领袖的职责。图纳表示，他仍致力于监督巴耶尔萨州政府，并重建 PDP，使其成为能够解决贫困问题、改善居民生活的政党。这名 PDP 主席还批评州政府为庆祝巴耶尔萨州成立30周年而进行的支出，要求州长杜耶·迪里的政府公布详细的支出账目。他呼吁政府披露支出总额，并指出批准举办此次庆典的预算项目。图纳说，如果查明公共资金遭到滥用，政府应向巴耶尔萨州居民道歉。他认为，周年庆典不应优先于居民面临的困难，包括饥饿、部分家长无力支付学费、医院药品短缺和道路状况恶劣等问题。这名 PDP 主席还进一步指控巴耶尔萨州议会未能对政府支出实施有效监督。然而，就本报道可获得的信息而言，有关周年庆典支出的说法以及针对图纳的指控均未得到独立证实。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家新闻和深入视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时随地接收全天候更新 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026103017.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 유럽의 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 동맹국들에 러시아를 자극하는 강경 발언을 자제하라고 요구한 것으로 전해졌다. 트럼프 행정부가 우크라이나 종전 협상을 재추진하는 가운데 유럽 동맹국들의 대러시아 발언 수위를 조절하려는 것으로 풀이된다. 30일(현지시간) 로이터 통신은 사안에 정통한 관계자 4명을 인용해 미 국방부가 최근 몇 주간 리투아니아와 라트비아, 에스토니아 등 발트 3국을 포함한 나토 회원국들에 러시아의 위협에 관한 공개 발언의 수위를 낮추라고 요청했다고 보도했다. 미국 측은 일부 유럽 지도자와 당국자들의 발언이 오히려 유럽의 안보를 해치고 있다고 주장한 것으로 전해졌다. 콜비 차관은 최근 발트 3국의 한 당국자에게 러시아를 '찌르는'(poking) 발언을 해서는 안 된다고 강조했다. 앞서 크리스텐 미할 에스토니아 총리는 지난 9월 말 우크라이나 전쟁에서 고전하는 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령을 궁지에 몰린 쥐에 비유한 바 있다. 한 유럽 당국자는 미국 측의 메시지를 "우리가 당신들을 돕고 있고, 미국인들이 그곳에 있다. 다만 목소리를 높이거나 소란을 피우지 말라"는 취지였다고 전했다. 미국의 이 같은 요구는 러시아가 유럽 내 사보타주(파괴공작)를 확대하고 있다는 서방 정보당국의 경고가 잇따르는 가운데 나왔다. 트럼프 행정부는 최근 대러 제재 완화와 경제협력 가능성을 제시하며 종전 협상을 추진하는 한편, 유럽 주둔 미군의 감축 가능성도 검토하고 있다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/10/30 20:14 송고 2026년10월30일 20시14분 송고

https://www.myjoyonline.com/absa-introdu.body: Absa Bank Ghana is expanding access to personal loans with its Instant Loans solution, allowing eligible salaried customers to borrow up to GH¢350,000 through the Bank’s digital banking platforms. The solution makes borrowing more accessible by enabling eligible customers to receive pre-approved personal loan offers and access funds instantly through a fully digital process. Customers can check for available offers through the Absa Mobile App, Internet Banking, or an Absa ATM and complete the process without collateral, a guarantor, or a lengthy loan application. Director of Personal and Private Banking at Absa Bank Ghana, Charles Addo, said the solution forms part of the Bank’s efforts to make banking services more responsive to customers’ needs and expectations. “We are seeing increasing demand for banking solutions that fit seamlessly into customers’ daily lives. Instant Loans lets eligible salaried customers access credit quickly through channels they already use, while ensuring lending decisions remain guided by robust risk and affordability assessments. Through automated credit assessment, eligible customers receive tailored, pre-approved personal loan offers and, once they accept an offer, access the funds immediately. The solution is intended to support customers who require timely access to personal credit while maintaining the risk management standards that underpin the Bank’s lending activities. Absa Instant Loans forms part of the Bank’s broader digital banking offering, through which it continues to invest in solutions that improve convenience, accessibility and flexibility for customers managing their financial needs

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/bade.body: British Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has condemned what she described as racist attacks against her after a former aide to Reform UK leader Nigel Farage called her a “Nigerian scammer”. Badenoch accused Reform UK politicians of exploiting her Nigerian background for political advantage, insisting that attempts to use her race against her would not succeed. She spoke during an interview on ITV’s Good Morning Britain on Thursday, following a series of social media posts by Raheem Kassam, a former senior aide to Farage. Kassam, who previously served as editor-in-chief of Breitbart News, described Badenoch as an “unrelenting scammer”. In another post, he wrote, “How are people still falling for this Nigerian scammer? Don’t give her your credit card number and bank account details!” Reacting to the comments, Badenoch said, “I think it just shows the sort of people they are.” “I think they think that maybe using my race is a way for them to improve their standing. “Britain is not a racist country, and because it’s not a racist country, their racist attacks and using my race as an attack form is not going to work,” she said. The controversy also drew attention to the response of Reform UK’s Treasury spokesman, Robert Jenrick, who declined to condemn Kassam’s comments. Asked during an ITV interview whether he considered the remarks racist, Jenrick said he did not, although he acknowledged that they could be unpleasant or rude. “It’s not my place to police everybody’s tweets who may or may not be a supporter of Reform,” he said. Farage had also faced questions over whether he considered Kassam’s comments racist during an appearance on BBC Breakfast earlier in the week. “I don’t think saying somebody grew up in Nigeria is racist,” he said. Following further questioning, Farage acknowledged that the comment was excessive but maintained that it was not deliberately racist. “Do I think the comment was over the top? Yes, I do. Do I think it was intentionally racist? No, I don’t,” he added. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/bade.title_zh: 巴登诺奇谴责针对“尼日利亚骗子”言论引发的种族主义袭击
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/bade.body_zh: 英国保守党党魁凯米·巴登诺赫谴责了她所称的针对自己的种族主义袭击。此前，英国改革党党魁奈杰尔·法拉奇的一名前助手称她是“尼日利亚骗子”。巴登诺赫指控英国改革党政客利用她的尼日利亚背景谋取政治优势，坚持认为企图利用她的种族身份攻击她不会得逞。周四，她在ITV《英国早餐》节目中接受采访时谈及此事。此前，法拉奇的前高级助手拉希姆·卡萨姆在社交媒体上连发多条帖子。卡萨姆曾担任《布赖特巴特新闻》总编辑，他将巴登诺赫形容为“死缠烂打的骗子”。在另一则帖子中，他写道：“人们怎么还在上当受骗，相信这个尼日利亚骗子？别把信用卡号码和银行账户信息给她！”针对这些言论，巴登诺赫表示：“我认为，这恰恰说明了他们是什么样的人。”“我认为，他们以为利用我的种族身份或许能提升自己的地位。英国不是一个种族主义国家，正因为英国不是种族主义国家，他们的种族主义攻击，以及把攻击我的种族身份当作一种手段，都不会奏效。”她说。这场争议也使外界关注到英国改革党财政事务发言人罗伯特·詹里克对卡萨姆言论的回应。詹里克拒绝谴责卡萨姆的言论。当在ITV采访中被问及是否认为这些言论具有种族主义色彩时，詹里克表示他不这样认为，尽管他承认这些言论可能令人不快或显得无礼。他说：“对于那些可能是也可能不是英国改革党支持者的推文，我无权逐一审查。”本周早些时候，法拉奇在BBC《早餐》节目中亮相时，也被问及是否认为卡萨姆的言论具有种族主义色彩。他说：“我不认为说某人是在尼日利亚长大的就是种族主义。”在进一步追问下，法拉奇承认该评论说过头了，但坚持认为这并非故意带有种族主义色彩。他补充道：“你认为这则评论是否过头了？是的，我认为过头了。你认为它是不是故意带有种族主义色彩？不，我不这么认为。”本文所表达的任何评论均不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/bayelsa-unveils-8t.body: The championship division tournament, which is open to draught players and members of the public, will take place at the King Odogu Draught Centre in Yenizuepie, Yenagoa, the state capital. In a statement, the Chairman of the Draught Tournament Committee, Dike Azuka Richard, and committee member King Odogu said the competition would showcase the skills and strategic abilities of draught players from across Bayelsa State. Describing the tournament as a clash of titans, the organisers said the event would provide a platform for players who are indigenes and residents of the state to compete for honours. The winner will receive ₦150,000, while the runner-up will earn ₦100,000 and the third-placed player ₦50,000. The fourth-placed participant will receive ₦20,000, while consolation prizes of ₦10,000 will be awarded to other participants. The committee said the tournament would be held under the chairmanship of the Paramount Ruler of Obunaghan Kingdom, HRH Peremobowei Yesibo (Ibolor XII). Former Bayelsa State Acting Governor, Rt Hon Wernispreye Seibarugu, and former Deputy Governor Peremobowei Ebebi are among the special guests of honour. Other dignitaries expected at the event include the Director of Sports Development, Lambert D. Harrison; Prof. Elliot Isibiri; Dr Peter Singabele; former Second Vice-President of the Ijaw National Congress, Alabo Nengi James, OON; Dr Godspower Epidi; and retired Brigadier-General M.J. The traditional fathers of the day are the Paramount Ruler of Opolo Community, HRH Tiniya Moneyman Negebo, and former Bayelsa State Commissioner for Science and Technology, Hon Chief Blessing Ipigansi Izagara. The eighth edition is expected to bring together draught enthusiasts and competitive players, while promoting the board game and providing an opportunity for participants to demonstrate their tactical skills.
